quote: Since in the final configuration every one of the \(T=2n(n-2)\) potential triples must be destroyed by at least one of the removed blocks
reason: The covering argument yields \(14b(n)\ge T=2n\max\{n-2,0\}\). Replacing this by \(2n(n-2)\) is justified only for \(n\ge2\). For \(n=1\), \(T=0\), not \(-2\). Although the displayed inequality happens to hold when \(n=1\), it requires a separate verification there.
